correctness.rationale: Diagonal entries give D_n=sup_k nr_k|1-r_ke^{iφ}|^n. Uniform log|1-re^{iφ}|=-br+O(r²) and exponential tails yield D_n=b^{-1}max_k(br_k)e^{-br_k}+O(1/n); the error bound follows from n²r³exp(-cnr)=O(1/n). The resolvent Ritt bound uses 1-|1-re^{iφ}|≥cr for 0<r≤r_1<2b. For y_j=bnr_j≥1>y_{j+1}, unimodality reduces the scalar max exactly to two adjacent modes. The crossing y=L(q_j)=log(1/q_j)/(1-q_j) gives the liminf, while n≈1/(br_j) gives limsup 1/(eb). For q=0 a geometric-mean time gives a zero trough; for q=1 both neighbors approach one. O(1/n) consecutive-step variation makes the whole cluster set an interval, not merely its endpoints. Monotonicity of L and h gives inverse uniqueness. Explicit summable ray sequences and scaling verify all-Schatten realizability; arbitrary smallness is for a fixed p, not uniform in p. No finite tests substitute for these all-n steps.
